title: Dasakam 94 – Tattvajñānōtpattiḥ
description: The chapter traces knowledge of Bhagwan’s all-pervading nature, the limits of worldly paths, the distinction of bondage and liberation, the cleansing force of bhakti, and the gopikas’ liberation through love.
translation_note: No vetted English stanza translation is supplied. translation_en remains empty; the supplied photo captions are preserved as commentary and are not treated as translation.

stanzas.sanskrit:
शुद्धा निष्कामधर्मैः प्रवरगुरुगिरा तत्स्वरूपं परं ते
शुद्धं देहेन्द्रियादिव्यपगतमखिलव्याप्तमावेदयन्ते ।
नानात्वस्थौल्यकार्श्यादि तु गुणजवपुः सङ्गतोऽध्यासितं ते
वह्नेर्दारुप्रभेदेष्विव महदणुतादीप्तताशान्ततादि ॥ ९४-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śuddhā niṣkāmadharmaiḥ pravaragurugirā tatsvarūpaṃ paraṃ te
śuddhaṃ dehendriyādivyapagatamakhilavyāptamāvedayante |
nānātvasthaulyakārśyādi tu guṇajavapuḥ saṅgato’dhyāsitaṃ te
vahnerdāruprabhedeṣviva mahadaṇutādīptatāśāntatādi || 94-1 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: People who follow the path of Dharma, without expecting the fruits of such actions realise the all pervasive nature of Bhagwan (Nirguna Swaroopam) which is different from the body, actions due to sense organs and Maya. Just like how the flame from fire varies in size depending on the size and quality of the log used, the realisation of the Swaroopam varies according to the quality of the person.

stanzas.sanskrit:
आचार्याख्याधरस्थारणिसमनुमिलच्छिष्यरूपोत्तरार-
-ण्यावेधोद्भासितेन स्फुटतरपरिबोधाग्निना दह्यमाने ।
कर्मालीवासनातत्कृततनुभुवनभ्रान्तिकान्तारपूरे
दाह्याभावेन विद्याशिखिनि च विरते त्वन्मयी खल्ववस्था ॥ ९४-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ācāryākhyādharasthāraṇisamanumilacchiṣyarūpottarāra-
-ṇyāvedhodbhāsitena sphuṭataraparibodhāgninā dahyamāne |
karmālīvāsanātatkṛtatanubhuvanabhrāntikāntārapūre
dāhyābhāvena vidyāśikhini ca virate tvanmayī khalvavasthā || 94-2 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: The fire of knowledge is ignited by the striking of two logs of wood, the lower one being the Guru's teachings, and the upper one the disciple who seeks knowledge. This fire of knowledge kindled, burns the forest full of many tendencies and desires due to an effect of past actions, and also the ignorance of identification with the body and the world. When mind becomes pure, the passion for knowledge fire subsides and results in realisation of Bhagwan.

stanzas.sanskrit:
एवं त्वत्प्राप्तितोऽन्यो न हि खलु निखिलक्लेशहानेरुपायो
नैकान्तात्यन्तिकास्ते कृषिवदगदषाड्गुण्यषट्कर्मयोगाः ।
दुर्वैकल्यैरकल्या अपि निगमपथास्तत्फलान्यप्यवाप्ता
मत्तास्त्वां विस्मरन्तः प्रसजति पतने यान्त्यनन्तान् विषादान् ॥ ९४-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
evaṃ tvatprāptito’nyo na hi khalu nikhilakleśahānerupāyo
naikāntātyantikāste kṛṣivadagadaṣāḍguṇyaṣaṭkarmayogāḥ |
durvaikalyairakalyā api nigamapathāstatphalānyapyavāptā
mattāstvāṃ vismarantaḥ prasajati patane yāntyanantān viṣādān || 94-3 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Surrendering to Bhagwan alone can remove all afflictions. Just by practicing the systems of Ayurveda, the six practices of Raja needhi, the six steps of actions of  Dharma shastra are ineffective in completely removing all sufferings. The rituals prescribed in the Vedas are hard to perform without mistakes and even when one manages to perform these successfully, get results, go to heaven and become proud and forgets Bhagwan & come back again in to the world and suffer miseries.

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्वल्लोकादन्यलोकः क्व नु भयरहितो यत्परार्धद्वयान्ते
त्वद्भीतः सत्यलोकेऽपि न सुखवसतिः पद्मभूः पद्मनाभ ।
एवं भावे त्वधर्मार्जितबहुतमसां का कथा नारकाणां
तन्मे त्वं छिन्धि बन्धं वरद कृपणबन्धो कृपापूरसिन्धो ॥ ९४-४ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tvallokādanyalokaḥ kva nu bhayarahito yatparārdhadvayānte
tvadbhītaḥ satyaloke’pi na sukhavasatiḥ padmabhūḥ padmanābha |
evaṃ bhāve tvadharmārjitabahutamasāṃ kā kathā nārakāṇāṃ
tanme tvaṃ chindhi bandhaṃ varada kṛpaṇabandho kṛpāpūrasindho || 94-4 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri wondered as to which place in this universe could be fearless like vaikunta? Even Brahma experiences fear in satyaloka knowing well, that he will merge with Bhagwan. Hence, what about human beings who keep committing sins by unrighteous means! Bhattathiri prayed to Bhagwan to remove all his attachments.

stanzas.sanskrit:
याथार्थ्यात् त्वन्मयस्यैव हि मम न विभो वस्तुतो बन्धमोक्षौ
मायाविद्यातनुभ्यां तव तु विरचितौ स्वप्नबोधोपमौ तौ ।
बद्धे जीवद्विमुक्तिं गतवति च भिदा तावती तावदेको
भुङ्क्ते देहद्रुमस्थो विषयफलरसान्नापरो निर्व्यथात्मा ॥ ९४-५ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
yāthārthyāt tvanmayasyaiva hi mama na vibho vastuto bandhamokṣau
māyāvidyātanubhyāṃ tava tu viracitau svapnabodhopamau tau |
baddhe jīvadvimuktiṃ gatavati ca bhidā tāvatī tāvadeko
bhuṅkte dehadrumastho viṣayaphalarasānnāparo nirvyathātmā || 94-5 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri says that who is merged in Thyselfness only, there is no bondage or liberation. Bhagwan's two aspects of Maya and enlightenment are like the two states of dreaming and awakening. The attached ones enjoy the fruits or pleasures sitting on the tree called body and the detached ones enjoy the everlasting joy.

stanzas.sanskrit:
जीवन्मुक्तत्वमेवंविधमिति वचसा किं फलं दूरदूरे
तन्नामाशुद्धबुद्धेर्न च लघु मनसः शोधनं भक्तितोऽन्यत् ।
तन्मे विष्णो कृषीष्ठास्त्वयि कृतसकलप्रार्पणं भक्तिभारं
येन स्यां मङ्क्षु किञ्चिद्गुरुवचनमिलत्त्वत्प्रबोधस्त्वदात्मा ॥ ९४-६ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
jīvanmuktatvamevaṃvidhamiti vacasā kiṃ phalaṃ dūradūre
tannāmāśuddhabuddherna ca laghu manasaḥ śodhanaṃ bhaktito’nyat |
tanme viṣṇo kṛṣīṣṭhāstvayi kṛtasakalaprārpaṇaṃ bhaktibhāraṃ
yena syāṃ maṅkṣu kiñcidguruvacanamilattvatprabodhastvadātmā || 94-6 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: To obtain liberation, one has to keep his mind clean and pure which is possible only by true devotion to Bhagwan. Bhattathiri requested that he may be granted such devotion and with guidance from the guru, he may attain oneness with Bhagwan.

stanzas.sanskrit:
शब्दब्रह्मण्यपीह प्रयतितमनसस्त्वां न जानन्ति केचित्
कष्टं वन्ध्यश्रमास्ते चिरतरमिह गां बिभ्रते निष्प्रसूतिम् ।
यस्यां विश्वाभिरामाः सकलमलाहरा दिव्यलीलावताराः
सच्चित्सान्द्रं च रूपं तव न निगदितं तां न वाचं भ्रियासम् ॥ ९४-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śabdabrahmaṇyapīha prayatitamanasastvāṃ na jānanti kecit
kaṣṭaṃ vandhyaśramāste cirataramiha gāṃ bibhrate niṣprasūtim |
yasyāṃ viśvābhirāmāḥ sakalamalāharā divyalīlāvatārāḥ
saccitsāndraṃ ca rūpaṃ tava na nigaditaṃ tāṃ na vācaṃ bhriyāsam || 94-7 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: In this world there are people who are totally engrossed in the study of Vedas and do not care to know about Bhagwan. They are unfortunate ones who have wasted their efforts like the cow which cannot give milk. Bhattathiri requested Bhagwan to make him avoid such words which do not describe the glory of HIM, HIS various forms, HIS pastimes.

stanzas.sanskrit:
यो यावान् यादृशो वा त्वमिति किमपि नैवावगच्छामि भूम-
-न्नेवं चानन्यभावस्त्वदनुभजनमेवाद्रिये चैद्यवैरिन् ।
त्वल्लिङ्गानां त्वदङ्घ्रिप्रियजनसदसां दर्शनस्पर्शनादि-
-र्भूयान्मे त्वत्प्रपूजानतिनुतिगुणकर्मानुकीर्त्यादरोऽपि ॥ ९४-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
yo yāvān yādṛśo vā tvamiti kimapi naivāvagacchāmi bhūma-
-nnevaṃ cānanyabhāvastvadanubhajanamevādriye caidyavairin |
tvalliṅgānāṃ tvadaṅghripriyajanasadasāṃ darśanasparśanādi-
-rbhūyānme tvatprapūjānatinutiguṇakarmānukīrtyādaro’pi || 94-8 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri feels he may not be aware of all the glory of Bhagwan, but he focuses himself on Bhagwan with complete devotion. He wants it to happen to him by worshipping, prostrating and singing to Bhagwan and touch the feet of the groups of people who are lovingly attached to Bhagwan’s feet.

stanzas.sanskrit:
यद्यल्लभ्येत तत्तत्तव समुपहृतं देव दासोऽस्मि तेऽहं
त्वद्गेहोन्मार्जनाद्यं भवतु मम मुहुः कर्म निर्मायमेव ।
सूर्याग्निब्राह्मणात्मादिषु लसितचतुर्बाहुमाराधये त्वां
त्वत्प्रेमार्द्रत्वरूपो मम सततमभिष्यन्दतां भक्तियोगः ॥ ९४-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
yadyallabhyeta tattattava samupahṛtaṃ deva dāso’smi te’haṃ
tvadgehonmārjanādyaṃ bhavatu mama muhuḥ karma nirmāyameva |
sūryāgnibrāhmaṇātmādiṣu lasitacaturbāhumārādhaye tvāṃ
tvatpremārdratvarūpo mama satatamabhiṣyandatāṃ bhaktiyogaḥ || 94-9 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri wants to surrender all the material benefits to Bhagwan. He wants to be HIS slave, clean the premises of the temple.  He wants to worship chaturbhuja form of Bhagwan in sun, fire, brahman,  atman.  By doing above, he hoped that the love in his heart melted and flowed like a torrential stream towards Bhagwan.

stanzas.sanskrit:
ऐक्यं ते दानहोमव्रतनियमतपः साङ्ख्ययोगैर्दुरापं
त्वत्सङ्गेनैव गोप्यः किल सुकृतितमाः प्रापुरानन्दसान्द्रम् ।
भक्तेष्वन्येषु भूयः स्वपि बहुमनुषे भक्तिमेव त्वमासां
तन्मे त्वद्भक्तिमेव द्रढय हर गदान् कृष्ण वातालयेश ॥ ९४-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
aikyaṃ te dānahomavrataniyamatapaḥ sāṅkhyayogairdurāpaṃ
tvatsaṅgenaiva gopyaḥ kila sukṛtitamāḥ prāpurānandasāndram |
bhakteṣvanyeṣu bhūyaḥ svapi bahumanuṣe bhaktimeva tvamāsāṃ
tanme tvadbhaktimeva draḍhaya hara gadān kṛṣṇa vātālayeśa || 94-10 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: It is not easy to attain moksha by charity, sacrifice, vows, disciplines, or by following Saankhya Yoga. But the fortunate Gopikas got moksha just by showing unconditional love to Bhagwan and he respects that true love only. He wished that devotion to strengthen in him permanently and worshipped to remove all his sufferings.
